title: A Noetherian ring is a G-ring if its maximal localizations have geometrically regular formal fibres
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Then $R$ is a G-ring [def-weil-pbc-g-ring] if and only if for every maximal ideal $\mathfrak m\subset R$ the completion map $R_{\mathfrak m}\to(R_{\mathfrak m})^\wedge$ is a regular ring map in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], where $R_{\mathfrak m}$ is the localization of $R$ at $\mathfrak m$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] and $(R_{\mathfrak m})^\wedge=\varprojlim_nR_{\mathfrak m}/\mathfrak m^nR_{\mathfrak m}$ its $\mathfrak mR_{\mathfrak m}$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] (in Stacks' words: $R_{\mathfrak m}$ has geometrically regular formal fibres). This is More on Algebra Lemma Tag 07PT.

split_report.summary: Read More on Algebra 07PT (lemma-check-G-ring-maximal-ideals) and its proof, Definition 07GH with the remark on formal fibres, 07BZ, 07C0, 07C1, 07QI, 07NT, 07PS, 0C4G, Algebra 00HR, 00HQ, 00HT, 00MC, 05GH. Proof follows Stacks in 9 steps: the trivial direction; choice of m containing p and a prime p' of (R_m)^ over pR_m (00MC); 07PS at p' for the Noetherian complete local ring (R_m)^; the identification (R_m)_{pR_m}=R_p and the flat local map phi: R_p -> (R_m^)_{p'}; two applications of 07QI (fibre rings Noetherian since the targets are Noetherian) with the regularity of a localization; descent of regularity through the localization R_m -> R_p; flatness (0C4G) and Spec surjectivity (00HR) of phi^: R_p^ -> (R_m^)_{p'}^, which Stacks leaves implicit; 07NT. New nodes: lem-weil-pbc-complete-local-g-ring (07PS), lem-weil-pbc-regular-composition (07QI), lem-weil-pbc-localization-regular and lem-weil-pbc-regular-through-localization (asserted without proof in 07PT), lem-weil-pbc-flat-completion (0C4G, one direction), all unsplit; lem-weil-pbc-flat-local-hom-faithfully-flat (00HR), Mathlib leaf Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom with PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat. Existing nodes reused: 07NT, 00MC (also gives the flatness of c, so 00MB is not cited), adic-completion-noetherian, local-completion-local-ring, adic-completion-mod-ideal, flat-local-ring-maps. 07C0 (lem-weil-pbc-regular-local-maximal) is not needed by this proof.
